title: A large gain the person says is right is placed; one still asked stays held (decision X4)
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027, after pay on Fri 25 Dec. The bank holds 100,000 (30,000 of it Free to spend left), the e-wallet 5,000, the cash 10,000. Pay of 250,000 on the 25th starts the period; Free to spend is 60,000 a month. At the check-in on Fri 8 Jan at 20:00 the person types 101,000 for the bank, 280,000 for the e-wallet (the bank's figure typed in the wrong box) and 13,000 for the cash. Every amount is made up. The person answers the cash question: the 13,000 is right (`gain: right`). The e-wallet question is still asked (`gain: asked`).

events.note: the bank's figure typed in the e-wallet's box

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 30,000 (Free to spend at the opening) + 1,000 (the bank's small gain) + 3,000 (the cash's gain, answered right, so placed: it gives back to Free to spend) = 34,000

asks.question: warnings
asks.why: The cash question is answered; only the e-wallet's is still asked.
